# Project Instructions

- This workspace is a Spanish-language personal portfolio built with Next.js App Router, React, and TypeScript.
- Keep project content centralized in `src/data/portfolio.ts` and preserve the existing editorial design system in `src/app/globals.css`.
- Do not invent portfolio facts, personal details, project imagery, email addresses, or social links. Use original source assets only; clearly mark any missing material.
- Preserve semantic HTML, keyboard focus visibility, responsive layouts, and `prefers-reduced-motion` support.
- Validate changes with `npm run lint`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, and `npm run build`.

## Setup Checklist

- [x] Requirements clarified from the supplied portfolio brief.
- [x] Next.js App Router project scaffolded in the workspace root.
- [x] Portfolio pages and responsive design implemented.
- [x] No extra VS Code extensions required.
- [x] Lint, TypeScript, and production build verified.
- [x] Development preview started at `http://localhost:3000`.
- [x] README and missing asset instructions included.
